fullTextEN: Hello everyone, I am Nika.
I come from China.

fullTextZH: 现在住在安徽省合肥市。
fullTextEN: I now live in Hefei, Anhui Province.

fullTextZH: 不管你有没有去过法国，
fullTextEN: Whether or not you have been to France,
you must have seen a logo,
a logo,

fullTextZH: 就是两个字母L、V叠在一起。
fullTextEN: which is two letters L and V overlapping.
Printed on bags and suitcases.
This brand is very famous.

fullTextZH: 对于很多人来说是很贵的品牌，
fullTextEN: For many people, it is a very expensive brand,
a very luxurious brand.
So we call it a luxury item.

fullTextZH: 有人愿意花很多钱买LV包包、LV箱子、
fullTextEN: Some people are willing to spend a lot of money on LV bags, LV suitcases,
LV clothes, etc.

fullTextZH: 很多好的商场里都有LV店。
fullTextEN: Many good malls have LV stores.
Maybe someone will ask:
"Isn't it just a brand that sells bags?

fullTextZH: 为什么能火100多年还这么贵呢？”
fullTextEN: Why has it been popular for over 100 years and still so expensive?"
Actually, the story of LV is very inspiring.

fullTextZH: 这个故事可能会给你新的启发、
fullTextEN: This story might give you new inspiration,
New ideas.

fullTextZH: LV的故事是从一个农村的孩子开始的。
fullTextEN: The story of LV starts with a child from the countryside.

fullTextZH: 让我们看看这个法国牌子是怎么来的。
fullTextEN: Let's see how this French brand came to be.
In 1821, in a French countryside,

fullTextZH: 有个叫路易·威登的小男孩出生了。
fullTextEN: a little boy named Louis Vuitton was born.
His family were carpenters,
such as tables and chairs.
Their life was very poor.

fullTextZH: 路易的生活因为一件事变得更难了。
fullTextEN: Louis's life became harder because of one thing.

fullTextZH: 他的妈妈在他10岁的时候死了。
fullTextEN: His mother died when he was 10 years old.
His father remarried quickly,

fullTextZH: 所以他的生活过得很不好。
fullTextEN: so his life was very bad.

fullTextZH: 14岁的路易做了一个大胆的决定：
fullTextEN: At 14, Louis made a bold decision:
to walk to Paris.

fullTextZH: 从他的家乡到巴黎有几百公里。
fullTextEN: It was several hundred kilometers from his hometown to Paris.
At that time, there were no trains,

fullTextZH: 汽车，整整走了两年才到。
fullTextEN: cars, it took two whole years to arrive.
After arriving in Paris,
Louis worked for a living,
learning various crafts,
Finally found a job.
Learned to make suitcases.
Louis is very smart,
and especially hardworking,

fullTextZH: 还自己想办法怎么把箱子做得更好。
fullTextEN: and he figured out how to make the suitcases better.

fullTextZH: 慢慢地，路易的手艺越来越棒。
fullTextEN: Gradually, Louis's craftsmanship became better and better.

fullTextZH: 连当时法国的王后都听说了他，
fullTextEN: Even the Queen of France at that time heard about him,
and became his customer,
and bought his suitcases.

fullTextZH: 听起来他已经很厉害了，
fullTextEN: It sounds like he was already very impressive,
Shouldn't he be very satisfied?

fullTextZH: 不，路易发现了一个问题。
fullTextEN: No, Louis discovered a problem.

fullTextZH: 当时的行李箱有一个特点：
fullTextEN: Suitcases at that time had a feature:
The top of the suitcase was round,

fullTextZH: 这是为了方便雨水流走。
fullTextEN: This was to allow rainwater to flow off easily.
But there was a problem with this—
If there were many suitcases,

fullTextZH: 没有办法一个一个地叠起来，
fullTextEN: there was no way to stack them one by one,
they could only be moved one by one,
which was very inconvenient.
Louis had a new idea:
Replace leather with fabric,

fullTextZH: 然后把行李箱的顶部改成平的。
fullTextEN: then make the top of the suitcase flat.
The suitcase he designed,

fullTextZH: 很快在巴黎的贵族里火了起来。
fullTextEN: quickly became popular among the Parisian nobility.

fullTextZH: 法国的王后也特别满意，
fullTextEN: The Queen of France was also very satisfied,

fullTextZH: 还把他推荐给了别的贵族。
fullTextEN: and recommended him to other nobles.

fullTextZH: 现在路易在巴黎很有名了。
fullTextEN: Now Louis is very famous in Paris.
After he saved enough money,

fullTextZH: 他在巴黎开了自己的店。
fullTextEN: he opened his own store in Paris.

fullTextZH: 店的名字就是他的名字——路易·威登，
fullTextEN: The store's name is his name—Louis Vuitton,

fullTextZH: 在店里卖他自己做的行李箱。
fullTextEN: selling the suitcases he made himself in the store.
This is the beginning of LV.

fullTextZH: 路易·威登的故事让我很感动的地方是：
fullTextEN: The part of Louis Vuitton's story that moves me is:

fullTextZH: 我们出发的时候并不知道路在哪里，
fullTextEN: When we set out, we didn't know where the road was,

fullTextZH: 可能在那个时候只有一个选择，
fullTextEN: maybe at that time there was only one choice,
we had to do it this way.

fullTextZH: 但是在你走上了这条路之后，
fullTextEN: But after you embark on this path,
you will meet many people,

fullTextZH: 很多事会带着你往前走。
fullTextEN: many things will lead you forward.

fullTextZH: 就像路易·威登离开家乡的时候，
fullTextEN: Just like when Louis Vuitton left his hometown,

fullTextZH: 他可能也不知道以后的生活会怎么样。
fullTextEN: he probably didn't know what his future life would be like.
He learned many skills,
endured a lot of hardships,

fullTextZH: 最后变成了一个有名的设计师，
fullTextEN: and eventually became a famous designer,
and even had his own brand.

fullTextZH: 今天的视频就到这里啦！
fullTextEN: That's all for today's video!
Do you like the LV brand?

fullTextZH: 为什么喜欢，或者为什么不喜欢呢？
fullTextEN: Why do you like it, or why don't you like it?
Remember to leave me a comment!
See you next time.
